entries.zh: 骑（骑马、跨骑牲畜）
entries.en: to ride (a horse), ride astride

entries.zh: 骑马（乘马而行）
entries.en: to ride on horseback

entries.zh: 纵（沿纵长方向直行，与横相对；另有放纵、纵容义）
entries.en: to go lengthwise, along the length (opposed to crosswise); to indulge, let loose

entries.zh: 纵横（纵横交错而行；引申指恣肆横行、骄纵无忌）
entries.en: lengthwise and crosswise, criss-cross; (in moral usage) wanton, unrestrained, overbearing

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: M 栏残缺（T99），汉字圍/團存疑，西语 ferrador 难解，仅官话栏 tûan 指向團（圆形）义，材料不足定释

entries.zh: 团圆（围拢成圆、环绕成圈；亦指团聚）
entries.en: to go round in a ring, encircle; round; also to reunite, come together again

entries.zh: 扒直行（拉直照直、径直而行，抄直路走）
entries.en: to go straight, walk in a direct line, take the shortest straight road

entries.zh: 横行（横着走、侧身斜行；引申指霸道横行）
entries.en: to walk sideways, crosswise; (fig.) to run rampant, act tyrannically

entries.zh: 赶路（加紧赶程、急忙赶道）
entries.en: to hurry on one's way, hasten along the road

entries.zh: 驾御（驾驭车马、驾车驱驰；引申指操控驾驭）
entries.en: to drive (a carriage/cart), rein and steer; to control, master
entries.notes: 西语 ostella 一词难解（或指某种车舆），不影响驾御主义

entries.zh: 齿露（牙齿外露突出、龅牙）
entries.en: to have protruding (buck) teeth, teeth sticking out

entries.zh: 小跌（小碎步急走、小步顿足而行）
entries.en: to walk with little quick steps, mince along
entries.notes: 跌 取小步顿足义（近蹀），与常义跌倒有别，依西语 menudito（小碎步）定释

entries.zh: 轻行（脚步轻快、小步急行）
entries.en: to walk lightly with quick small steps

entries.zh: 轻步行（轻步小走、缓步轻踏）
entries.en: to walk with little light steps, go on small soft steps

entries.zh: 眩晕（头昏目眩、头旋）
entries.en: to be dizzy, giddy; the head swims (vertigo)
entries.notes: H 首字佰/兩存疑、西语 almodada 拼写难解，据眩字与 M lē hīn、R lià hiên 及 andarse la cabeça（头昏旋运）定眩晕义

entries.zh: 四脚爬（四肢着地、手脚并用爬行）
entries.en: to go on all fours, crawl

entries.zh: 游方（云游四方、周游各地）
entries.en: to travel about, wander the world; of itinerant monks, to go from place to place

entries.zh: 踏遍天下（走遍天下各地）
entries.en: to travel all over the world, tread every land

entries.zh: 独步行（独自步行、单步而行；亦指缓步徐行）
entries.en: to walk alone, step by oneself; (Sp. head) to walk slowly at spaced steps
entries.notes: 西语 a espaçios y pasos（按步徐行）与汉字独步（独行）侧重不同，主义依 H/M/R 定独步行

entries.zh: 迈大步（大地步：跨大步行走，缓急皆可）
entries.en: to take long strides, walk with big steps (slowly or quickly)

entries.zh: 车轮（车轮转动、滚行；轮字或作轆）
entries.en: (of a coach/cart) the wheels to turn and roll
entries.notes: H 輪/轆存疑（皆指轮子），西语 cache 当读 coche（车）

entries.zh: 打跤（摔跤打斗；跤或作破则为打破，两读存疑）
entries.en: to wrestle, grapple (if 跤); to break (if 破) — reading unresolved
entries.notes: H 跤/破两读相争、西语 contrabajo 义难解，M pà guā 偏跤、R tà pōa 偏破，语义无法定夺
